chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his wife in what is below the private part. He said: 'Upon him is a camel, and he is not required to perform Hajj next year. And if the woman followed him in intercourse, then upon her is like what is upon him. And if he forced her, then upon him are two camels, and upon both of them is Hajj next year.' The end of the narration.

key_terms.الْفَرْجِ: Private part (specifically the vagina in this context)
key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: A mature female camel (a specific type of sacrificial animal)

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for sexual intercourse during Ihram outside the private part?
ai.summary: This narration from Sahih al-Tusi clarifies the specific fiqh of 'dhubul jism' (intercourse outside the vulva) during Ihram, establishing that it incurs the penalty of a camel (badanah) but does not invalidate the current Hajj, unlike full intercourse. The hadith further distinguishes between mutual consent and coercion, imposing a heavier penalty of two camels on the husband if he forced his wife, highlighting the juristic nuance in assigning liability based on the nature of the act.
